notes: Straight line and arrow markup tools, and moving a mark to another layer now matches it to that layer.

fixes: The line and arrow draw tools now draw straight lines. Both were tracing the pointer like the pen, so line drew a freehand squiggle and arrow drew the same squiggle with an arrowhead.
Moving a mark to another layer now redraws it at that layer mark size, the same way merging two layers does.
Moving a mark between layers measured at different zooms now places it correctly on the sheet. It was being copied across without rescaling.
